title: Contact and Merchant Information
description: This page shows the public information that payment providers and customers expect to find on the website. Sensitive documents, director details, UBO details, and bank information are not published here and are uploaded only inside Stripe or Airwallex onboarding portals.

companyName.label: Legal English company name
companyName.value: To be provided (Hong Kong registered company)

registrationNumber.label: Company registration number / business registration number

supportEmail.label: Support email
supportEmail.value: To be provided; support@yourdomain is recommended

supportPhone.label: Support phone
supportPhone.value: To be provided; a real reachable phone number is recommended

supportHours.label: Support hours
supportHours.value: To be provided; Hong Kong business hours are recommended

portalOnly.title: Documents uploaded only in payment provider portals
portalOnly.description: These items are usually used for KYC/KYB review and should not be published as website content.

items.directors: Director identity documents, proof of address, and personal KYC information
items.owners: Ultimate beneficial owner information and ownership structure
items.bank: Bank account proof, settlement account details, or other supporting documents requested by the payment provider
